message_content: Mom, Happy New Year! Good morning, the chicken soup rice noodles for breakfast were really delicious, thank you, Mom!
Teacher He Lu, I will arrive on time for this afternoon's yoga class. Thank you!
Yuwei, breakfast is on the table, remember to eat. It's colder today, dress warmly.
Jiajia, I've designed the morning journal template—it has such a sense of ceremony!
Dad, the fish tonight is very fresh, thank you both!
Mom: Weiwei, what do you want for lunch? I'm about to go grocery shopping.
Jingjing, Mom made mushroom chicken soup, so happy! Good luck at the afternoon sharing session!
Xinran, today Zhang Jing and I found a 1990s collection of essays about Kunming street life at Rubber Bookstore. Such a pleasant surprise!
Jingjing, we're having fried sauce noodles for lunch. Mom made them and they're super delicious! We're also discussing my sister coming back to make flower cakes, and then we'll eat them together.
Me: Jingjing, I just bought fresh strawberries at the market, they're really sweet. For lunch I had tomato egg noodles. In the afternoon I'll keep writing!
Yang Fan, nice to meet you! Let's go check out Yemu Bookstore together next time. Looking forward to it.
Sisi, see you at the art museum at 1:55 PM—don't forget to bring your coffee~

[ZhongAn Insurance] Dear Ms. Sun Yuwei, you have successfully purchased a one-year comprehensive accident insurance policy (policy number PI20250225856XXXX), with coverage of 500,000 yuan and a premium of 380 yuan. The coverage period is valid until 2026-02-25. Reply "1" to view the electronic policy.
Mom: Breakfast is ready, hurry up and get up to eat. Today I steamed your favorite egg custard.
Mom, I'm heading to school now. I'll arrive in about two hours and come back this evening.
[Yuerong Skin Care Studio] You have successfully booked the basic cleansing and hydration treatment for next Tuesday at 14:00. Please arrive on time. To reschedule, please call 0871-12345678.
Jingjing, today during the walk I heard so many stories about the old food market from Aunt Xie. It was really rewarding!
Uncle Qin, I've received the payment for my manuscript! Thank you for recommending that book—it inspired me a lot.
Uncle Qin, I'll go to the bookstore this morning to look at The Production of Space. Please save a window seat for me. Thanks!
I'm about to go donate clothes. Where are you?
Manman, today Mom and I went to Dounan and bought peonies and lisianthus, and arranged them in two vases. So happy!
Me: Jingjing, I've set off, Metro Line 3, see you at the cinema in a bit!
Mom, I'm organizing your old photos. Seeing how beautiful you looked when you were young!
Mom, I just read A History of Collecting Folk Music in Yunnan. It discusses the origin of the horse-driving tune, which is very interesting. I'll tell you about it when I come home this weekend.
Jingjing, I finished my school-leaving procedures today. Four years passed by so quickly.
Uncle Qin, the copy for the graduation-season old book drifting event is finalized. I've sent it to your email; please check.
Editor Xu, the manuscript has been revised per your comments and submitted by email. Please check.
Mom, I'm coming down for lunch now.
Sis, during dinner today Mom and Dad talked about when I was little. It felt so warm.
Sis: Mom and Dad made really delicious rice noodles today. Come back this weekend and try some?
Sis: Congratulations on finishing the draft! Awesome! Remember to rest more after the shot. See you at Dounan Flower Market in August ~
Editor Xu, I have revised the manuscript according to your suggestions, deleted three pieces, and made the structure more compact. Please take a look when you have time.
Sis, this morning Mom and Dad made brown sugar congee and fried eggs, so heartwarming!
Jingjing, on Sunday I'll buy fresh matsutake mushrooms for you at Zhuanxin Market. How many jin do you need?
Mr. Wu, I'll bring you a sample copy of 'Slow Travel Notes' this afternoon. I've marked some revisions. Would it be convenient if I arrive around two?
Me: Jingjing, I just got back from a walk with Mom and Dad. Dad bought freshly baked flower cakes to have as breakfast tomorrow~
Jingjing, today I went for a walk with Mom and Dad at Green Lake. They told lots of old stories, and I wrote them all down. I feel like I can use them in my essay collection again.

Editor Xu, the revised draft of the column is almost done. I'd like to confirm with you: regarding the detailed description of the early morning on Wenlin Street, should I add some material from interviews with people?
Zhang Jing: Dear, I found a newly opened coffee shop. The vibe is amazing. Let's go check it out together next time! [Image]
Mom, breakfast was delicious. I'm about to head to Xishan, don't worry!
In the morning I did meditation and stretching, and felt especially refreshed! I had breakfast with Mom, milk, bread and eggs, simple and satisfying. A new day begins!
Yang Wenyou, thank you for your advice yesterday. I adjusted the ambient sound at the beginning as you suggested and sent the revised paragraph in the attachment. What do you think?
Sisi, the new running shoes are here, and the cushioning is amazing! After the exam tomorrow, let's go for a run.
Jingjing, the small-pot rice noodles Mom made this morning were super delicious. Having a bowl after my morning run was so satisfying!
Lulu, today's run was great! I'm counting on you for next week's interval running and strength training plan. Looking forward to it!
Sis, we're having breakfast right now, and then we're going to take a family photo!
Jingjing, I started using a new journal today and listed all the things I need to do today. It feels amazing!
Mom, today's plain congee and boiled eggs were especially delicious. Thank you!
Jingjing! I just finished a watercolor painting, Cuihu Autumn, and I'm super satisfied! Let me show you!
Jingjing, Mom made chicken soup rice noodles, super fragrant! After eating, heading to the exam, nervous and excited~
The side dishes are almost ready. Tonight’s crossing-the-bridge rice noodles are waiting for you!
Editor Xu, the revision of the essay "The Depth of Green" is done. I mainly optimized the descriptions of rainforest sounds. Could you take a look when you have time?
Uncle Qin, I found a few small-size postcard album styles. I'll send you screenshots to look at. When you have time, shall we discuss?
Me: Editor Xu, the first draft of "Winter Fireworks at Zhuanxin Market" has been sent to your email. Please check it.
Today I woke up early and meditated; it felt great. Mom made breakfast, and I was in a good mood.
Sis, today I told Mom and Dad the good news about publication while walking with them. I'm so happy!
Teacher Sun, I was so happy to run into you at the bookstore today! I really like your book, and I've followed your official account.
Morning, Lulu, how did your morning exercise go today? I did yoga and meditation and feel great, sharing this with you.

[Elephant Screening] You have successfully purchased a ticket for the 19:00 screening of the movie 'Southern Afternoon', seat number Row 7 Seat 5, ticket code 123456. Please pick up your ticket 15 minutes before the show.
Jingjing: I ran 9.5 kilometers this morning and felt great! I'm free later this afternoon, let's chat.
Oh my god, it's as beautiful as a painting! You're so skillful!
Yuwei, I recently read the book you recommended, The Fiction of Realist Fiction, and found it quite interesting. Let's discuss it when you're free!
I'm here, at the window seat. I ordered you a peach oolong tea. Waiting for you~
Yuwei, I’ve arrived at Zhibushi Bookstore. I ordered a latte for you. Waiting for you~

Xiaoyu, last Tuesday you said you wanted to experience an eco-farm, the one I mentioned to you at Cisufang, called 'Cang'eryuan Ecological Farm' in Yousuo Town, Eryuan County. It's a pretty nice place.
Just saw a Dali travel guide mentioning a place called 'Erhai Source Ecological Farm' with an amazing organic fruit and vegetable picking experience. Do you want to go together?

Mom, Su Man and I found a lot of dead branches and broken vines at Dounan Flower Market. I borrowed a small cart, and she picked peach branches and forget-me-nots. We're going to make an installation—it's really interesting!

Hello, Sun Yuwei. I'm Zhang Qiming, an editor at Shanghai Qingniao Publishing House. I just saw your 'Color Atlas of the Wet Market: Kunming's Lively Life' on Xiaohongshu. The narrative angle is very unique. I'd like to talk to you about the possibility of publishing a book. Would it be convenient to add me on WeChat?

Haha, I'm so happy today! The paper is submitted, the bonus has arrived, and I told my parents I'll take them to Sanya during winter break. My dad got really excited, patted me on the shoulder and said, 'My daughter has grown up!'
Mom, today I signed a florist agreement with Jingxin Yoga Life Studio, with a monthly salary of 800 yuan and free yoga classes. I'm so happy!
Yuwei, the Old Street chapter lacks historical depth. You can consult sources such as the “Kunming City Gazetteer” to supplement it.
WeChat Pay received 500.00 yuan, note: Family portrait sponsorship fund (Weiwei advance version).
Yuwei, today when I was doing a thorough cleaning, I found your childhood copies of Children's Literature and your composition notebooks. Do you still remember the little stories you wrote back then?
Yuwei, remember to buy apples and milk tomorrow.
Finally got it! [Attachment: Screenshot of the acceptance letter from Southwest Literature]
Finally got it! [Attachment: Screenshot of the acceptance letter from Southwest Literature]

Waiting for your good news!

Dear Ms. Sun, the afterword is deeply moving and fits perfectly with the prose style of Slow Travel Notes. The editorial committee has confirmed it for publication. We will follow up on the contract details later. Congratulations!

Zheng Yu: Let's start a "One Mountain a Month" plan and climb one mountain near Kunming every month. What do you think?
Me: Good idea! Qipan Mountain or Jiaozi Snow Mountain would both be great; we can try one next time.

Don't be nervous, I'll be with you during the blood draw.

Dear Ms. Sun Yuwei, I am an editor at Qinghe Publishing House. I have read your journal-sharing posts on Xiaohongshu, and the content and style are very appealing. I would like to ask whether you are willing to compile your journal into a book for publication. Looking forward to your reply.
You spent 9,999 yuan at the Apple Store on March 20 at 13:45 (MacBook Air).
Yuwei, don’t be nervous during the blood draw, Mom is right here beside you.
Yuwei, Sisi and I are downstairs. We're coming up right now, open the door!
At Yuerong, she bought a 158-yuan combination sunscreen (physical and chemical) and paid directly with WeChat.
You spent 9,999 yuan at an Apple authorized store. Merchant name: Apple Store Kunming Shuncheng.
I've arrived at the South Gate, brought iced coffee, and am waiting for you.
Yuwei, I'm at the milk tea shop, in the usual spot. I ordered you a brown sugar pearl milk tea.

Dear Editor, thank you very much for your invitation. I am currently focusing on writing the essay collection “Notes on Slow Living” and would like to finish this work first. As for publishing my journal, I hope we can collaborate again in the future. Thank you again for your recognition!
Hello, I'm Sun Yuwei. It was very nice to meet you tonight. If you're free, we can find some time to chat privately about writing insights?
I've signed up! Attached is the successful registration screenshot. Please bring me along!
Thank you for sharing! I'm Zhou Min. Would you mind adding me on WeChat? We can chat more about bookstore culture next time.
Of course, here is my WeChat ID: sunywei. Nice to meet you!

Tonight's book club sharing went very smoothly! I focused on 'Hui'an House' in 'Old Stories of the South of the City' and the quiet atmosphere of Mingyuan Bookstore. When answering questions from book friends, I also cited what I had seen and heard on last week's field visit to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market.

Hello Yuwei, I am Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision. The contract invitation and electronic contract link for the Kunming Slice column have been sent to your email. Please check and read them carefully. Feel free to contact me if you have any questions.

Got your marathon registration screenshot — awesome! As planned, we'll start with 3 km runs along the Panlong River, meeting every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday at 7 p.m. For running shoes, I recommend the Asics GT-2000; they're suitable for flat feet.
Just bought a copy of Literary Appreciation at a newsstand and am going home to read it carefully.
Today at Xiaoshu Library I read Records of Jiangnan Gardens and Tadao Ando's architecture collection, and I was especially inspired — light really does become a building material here.
The manuscript "Morning Hustle and Bustle on Wenlin Street" has been sent. Please check it.
Dad, is the weekend exhibition visit on Saturday or Sunday, and what time exactly should we go?
See you at Zhongmou at 2 p.m., remember to bring your yoga mat.
Mom's intervention plan is underway—time to look polished too!
Checked into Qiyun Xiaoyuan smoothly. The owner, Sister Yang, was especially warm-hearted and even helped carry my luggage and showed me around the courtyard. It feels great!
I'm at the entrance of Xiaojipo Community. Are you there yet?

Today is a great day!
Sweetie, tonight I'll make you a mushroom omelet to celebrate!

Boss Qin, I came by tonight to pick up 6 sets of Four Seasons of Cuihu. Thanks! Next time I'll bring you the photos of the misty scenery of Xishan.

“Your sharing showed me a different Kunming. I got a membership at Xiangxing Bookstore, but I never thought it had anything to do with Old Stories of the South of the City. Let’s go exploring together next time!”
Continue tomorrow at 9 a.m.; the layout plan will follow what we discussed.
The tent and tables and chairs are all packed up. I'm exhausted and drenched in sweat. I'll head off first; see you at the subway station?

At the temple fair's used-book stall, I found Kunming Folk Tales and a collection of Wang Zengqi's essays — only 15 yuan!
I saw Dad and you; I'm coming out now.
Dad sent a New Year red envelope. Happy New Year!

Tonight's family dinner was wonderful! Dad told funny stories about organizing lantern festivals when he was young, and Mom teased about the romantic times when she and Dad dated at Green Lake. The atmosphere was super warm.
Mom, I'm up! I'm about to go do yoga by West Lake. The morning here is really pleasant.
Tonight I'll ride a shared bike to Wulin Night Market, taking Beishan Street and Huancheng West Road. Feels great 😊
Arrived at Shen Garden, about to go inside and take a look.
I just bought a signed copy of "Ordinary Lanes of Hangzhou" at the Innocent Age Book Bar. The clerk told me the story of Baoshi Mountain. It was quite interesting.

Mom, I'm home. Tonight's Dragon Boat Festival family dinner was so wonderful. Thank you for the dishes you made!
Just celebrated passing the thesis defense with my advisor and roommate at Manshiguang Coffee—so happy!
My defense went excellently today. I just got home, so happy!
Yuwei, I've already packed my luggage. I'm taking the 15:00 high-speed train home this afternoon. Let's meet up again at the graduation ceremony!
We've agreed: let's meet every June! Friendship forever!
Sisters, I actually held downward dog for 45 seconds today! Teacher He Lu praised me for making great progress. So happy 😄
We had such a great chat at Ziyuan Café today. Remembering how we got lost hiking in freshman year — I'm dying laughing.
Today I sorted out some old clothes and donated them. I also took photos as a keepsake, and now I feel much more refreshed!
Would Saturday afternoon be convenient for taking a family photo?
Mom, my throat feels sore. I'm not going for a walk at Green Lake tonight; you two go ahead.
Yuwei, in class today I saw that your throat was uncomfortable. Remember to drink more pear soup—it’s good for your throat!
In the morning, talked with Mom about the Wenlin Street field trip, and she gave me some leads on old shops.
Just got home. Changing my clothes. See you this afternoon.
Just saw an elderly couple; the old gentleman helped the old lady straighten her collar. So heartwarming.
This morning, while running at Green Lake, I saw black-headed gulls—so beautiful!
He Lu, let's meet at the yoga studio at 13:30. After class, if you're free, want to go to that newly opened vegetarian restaurant next door?
Hello Coach Yang, this is Sun Yuwei. I'd like to confirm that the Subject 2 curve driving practice next Monday (September 22) afternoon is still at the same time, right? Thanks!
Just wrote down the inspiration 'spatial memory' in my journal.
The Kunming Folk Tales I picked up yesterday came in handy, and my cousin was completely absorbed!
For the wabi-sabi miniature landscape sketch, I came up with deadwood and a clay pot. Later, could you help me take a look at the succulent varieties?
Today I had my body composition measured in the nutrition department. The doctor said both my weight and body fat are low and told me to eat more eggs, dairy, and meat.
I'm going to Dounan Flower Market by myself; I'll send you photos when I get there!
Did you receive the Yunnan tea?
What do you all think of the western Yunnan self-driving loop plan I mentioned at lunch?
It's really pleasant to sip tea after yoga; this aged tea head is quite nice.
Today I interviewed Mom. She talked about many of her memories of being a teacher, and I recorded it.
Today I went to the study to wrap a gift for you. I used kraft paper and hemp twine, and added eucalyptus leaves.
See you at the bookstore at 7 tonight. Remember to bring tea snacks and flower cakes.
This morning I ran 9.5 km at a 5'20" pace, breaking my personal record!
The linguistics exam yesterday went really well — I had reviewed the last question. So happy!
Changed into a sports T-shirt and leggings and went out for morning exercise.
At today's sharing session, I met a painter named Xiao Meng. He was very interested in my idea of a sound map of the food market, and we agreed to go to Green Lake next time to collect sounds.
Yuwei, this is a screenshot of the hiking route to Jianshan at Fuxian Lake. The lakeside boardwalk is very safe; you can do it during the May Day holiday.
Mom, the asparagus fern on the balcony is really withered; the leaves crumble at a touch.
Tomorrow's Dounan pop-up, don't forget to bring the DSLR, spare battery charger, and that canvas tote bag.

Uncle Qin, good morning! I just finished reading the issue of "Prose" magazine you kept for me. The piece about the market in a small town in Yunnan was wonderfully written. I copied down many sentences. Tonight I'm planning to go watch that Yunnan-themed film via Elephant Doc.
Don't forget, I'll take you to the cultural center to see the exhibition this weekend.
Yuwei, what do you think about the old place names exhibition research we mentioned while walking around Cuihu Lake yesterday? Are you interested in helping?
Sister Zhao, I really enjoyed the tea ceremony class today. I look forward to going to Green Lake for tea together next time! Which day is convenient for you?
Morning creative work and tasks in the study.
Mom, I'm just organizing my journal. I'm planning to print out the photos of Cuihu Lake and paste them in. I think it will look really nice.
Just arrived at the flower market. I bought three bunches of blue snowflakes and one bunch of lisianthus, and I plan to pick out some eucalyptus leaves.
Today I took a meditation class for the first time at Jingxin Yoga Studio. The teacher was Zhao Lihua, and it felt good.
Today I borrowed a few books on spatial theory from the library. Let's discuss them when you have time.
Yuwei, let's meet at Cisufang at 6 tonight for a vegetarian dinner~
Check-in! Today I ran 3 kilometers along the Panlong River for the first time, with a pace of 7:30 per kilometer, and it felt great!
I've annotated the line draft. The revision suggestions for the jacaranda and magnolia are written on paper. Let's video chat at 8 p.m.~
Today I went to Dounan Flower Market with Sister Su Man, bought a lot of flower arrangement tools, spent 280 yuan, and also bought some flowers for tomorrow's class!
Just now I was rehearsing the reading passage from “Farewell, Seagull” and adjusting my tone and rhythm—it's getting smoother and smoother! See you at this afternoon's sharing session~
Just finished eating, about to read on the living room sofa for a while.

Mom, shall we go to Dounan Flower Market this weekend? I checked the weather for Saturday, and it’s supposed to be nice. I also heard peonies are in season recently—perfect for buying some to put in a vase.
Sure, let's go on Saturday morning. I checked and it opens at 9. If we set off at 8:30, we'll get there just in time. Your dad said he's not going.
Yuwei, I’m so looking forward to that ritualistic plan you mentioned at lunch today! I’ve already prepared the stationery.
Finally went for it!
Gear upgrade! I'll take beautiful photos for you all from now on!
Today's discussion with Professor Wu went very well. He affirmed my ideas and recommended three related books. It feels like my thinking is much clearer, and I feel relieved.
I found the guide for handling social insurance for flexible employment; I'll go to the social security center next week to ask.
The defense is today, I'm so nervous.

The first stage (adjustment period) emphasizes protein and vegetable intake, with a daily protein recommendation of 60–80 g (mainly chicken breast, fish, shrimp, and eggs) and at least 500 g of vegetables. The second stage (consolidation period) adds high-quality carbohydrates such as brown rice and quinoa. The third stage (intensification period) strictly controls sugar. Details are in the attachment; feel free to contact me anytime with questions.
Mom, I'll bring you some brown sugar pearl milk tea after the afternoon yoga class.

Great initiative! I saw the photos and notes, and they look great. Your mom's suggestion is very practical. Let me recommend a few frozen bento meals you can prepare in advance: chicken breast with broccoli, tomato beef, and pumpkin quinoa.
Remember to drink more water to relieve dryness.
Wang Ting, this morning I made vegetable egg rolls, took photos and wrote notes. My mom suggested I prep ingredients on the weekend. What do you think?

Today I was bitten by a stray dog. I just got my shots and came home; my mom is taking care of me.
Group leader Chen Ming, today's event was very successful. For the next event, I can help with registration and host some segments. Is that okay?
I just finished the "Ink and Breath" online sharing session. I hosted it smoothly, the discussion was lively, and I also agreed to write a summary for the next issue.
Thank you, Yuwei, for hosting today's reading event at Zhibushi Bookstore. You did a great job.

Yuwei, the afterword to the prose piece you just read was so beautiful — it had a rain-washed purity that moved me to tears.
Xiao Sun, your essay is quite good overall, but the paragraph transitions are a bit stiff. Pay attention to cohesion. The description of the plane tree leaves is very poetic. Keep it up. Come on!

Yuwei, in the rainforest passage of your 'Depth of Green', the sound description reminds me of a musical score — it's so beautiful! I'd like to exchange manuscripts with you. I'll send you my draft on November 10, and you give feedback on the 15th. Then I'll read your finished manuscript within a week and use Word comments to highlight the rhythm of description and the texture of details. What do you think?
The silk scarf is so beautiful! All my colleagues said it looked great. Thank you, babe. Your dad said the preserved mustard greens are perfect for making braised pork. Let's have it tomorrow!

Good morning, Linlin! Have you seen the flower language copy? Let me know if you have any thoughts~ Don't hesitate if you need me to change anything! I also signed up for a watercolor class, so I can draw material for you in the future, haha!
Bought all the art supplies, spent 520 yuan.
Teacher He, I arrived early. I've been doing flower arrangements all day and my shoulders are really sore, so I'll warm up on my own first.
Yuwei, I made fish with pickled mustard greens and asparagus stir-fried shrimp tonight. Hurry home for dinner.
Mom and Dad! My graduation defense was rated excellent!!! I'm so happy!

You spent 195 yuan at Dounan Flower Market on October 24 at 15:30; your balance is 1234.56 yuan.
